metadata.description: I'm Hassan Jamal, founder of PandaCodeGen. We build custom Next.js websites for businesses migrating away from slow platforms like WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, and Webflow. Every site we build is guaranteed to load in under 1 second and score 95 to 100 on Google PageSpeed Insights. Zero monthly hosting fees on Vercel's free tier. No plugins. No vendor lock-in. Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript, Vercel, Sanity CMS, Cloudflare. Based in Austin, Texas. Serving clients worldwide. Contact: info@pandacodegen.com
